Follows Claude Code 2.1.305: in iTerm2 3.5 and later, attachment thumbnails and rounded bubble corners are drawn as pictures in fullscreen rendering.

- In iTerm2 3.5 or later, with fullscreen rendering, outside tmux and screen, attachment thumbnails and rounded bubble corners are drawn as images, as they already are in kitty
- Thumbnails larger than 2 MiB, the main screen (not fullscreen), and older iTerm2 versions keep the `[Image #N]` text and square corners
- Needs Claude Code 2.1.305 or later

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
